quizData.question: When should you use a watcher instead of a computed property?

options.text: When you need to perform side effects like API calls
When you need to derive new data from existing data
When you need to bind to form inputs

quizData.explanation: Watchers are designed for side effects (async operations, DOM updates) when data changes. Computed properties are for synchronous derived data.
